query: Our Hive schema check started failing in CI. The step runs `hive schema:check schema.graphql --commit "$CI_COMMIT_SHA" --author "$CI_COMMIT_AUTHOR"` with HIVE_TOKEN set from a project access token, and the log ends with an error whose code is [102]. What is wrong?
expected_behavior: Looks up error code 102 on the Hive CLI errors page (https://the-guild.dev/graphql/hive/docs/api-reference/cli#errors) instead of guessing its meaning
Identifies that the command has no --target, and that project and organization access tokens need --target <organization>/<project>/<target> (or a target ID) on every command
Suggests running hive whoami with the same token to confirm its permissions if the error persists after the fix
Proposes the corrected command using only flags confirmed in the CLI command reference
Does not suggest deprecated flags such as --token or --registry
